# AsuraVerse Esports

> AsuraVerse Esports Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian competitive esports organization founded in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. We compete in BGMI (Battlegrounds Mobile India) and are focused on talent development, content creation, and long-term esports ecosystem growth in India.

## Organization

- **Full Name:** AsuraVerse Esports Pvt. Ltd.
- **Short Name:** AsuraVerse / Team AsuraVerse
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
- **Game:** BGMI (Battlegrounds Mobile India)
- **Website:** https://asuraverse.in

## What We Do

AsuraVerse Esports participates in competitive BGMI tournaments across India. We are a founder-led, independently operated esports organization with a community-driven growth approach and a partnership-focused expansion strategy.

## Tournament History

- **Bihar State Open Esports Championship** — #4 in Quarter Finals | Prize Pool: ₹5,75,000
- **Tortuga Gaming Scrims** — #1 in T1 Scrims, qualified for Invitational
- **7K Tournament** — #6 in Grand Finals | Prize Pool: ₹7,000
